fields.why: The headline claims combine a 1980-vs-1997 decline (pair) with rankings of rates across many industries, occupations, age groups and states (group); most of the reported contrasts span three or more groups, so group is slightly better, but pair is defensible for the trend headline.

The report gives national estimates and a separate 'State Estimates' section with state-specific counts and rates (e.g. Alaska 22.7 per 100,000), which matches the brief's 'national and subnational results reported together'.

brief_issues: 'When pair and group comparisons coexist, use the primary contrast' does not settle cases where a two-point trend and multi-group rankings are both headline claims.
